title: Israeli Forces Bulldoze Houses in al-Mansouri, Drones Fly Over Beirut
detail: Overnight into Thursday, Israeli forces conducted artillery strikes on Ali al-Taher, Kfartebnit and Hadatha, airstrikes on al-Mansouri, al-Qantara and Majdalzoun, and heavy controlled detonations in Bani Hayyan, Beit Leef, Kfartebnit and Zawtar al-Sharqiyeh. Israeli ground forces bulldozed houses in al-Mansouri. Israeli reconnaissance drones were also seen flying over Beirut and its southern suburbs, a rare extension of activity beyond the southern border districts. No casualties were reported.

media.caption: Israeli forces demolish houses in al-Mansouri amid overnight south Lebanon operations, Sep 17, 2026
